text: The Belgian National Lottery, whose brand is Lotto, is a public law limited company that comes under the direct supervision of the Belgian government via the Minister of Finance and the Minister of the Budget.
short: The National Lottery (Lotto) is a public-law company under direct Belgian government supervision.

source.name: FPS Finance (Belgium.be): National Lottery
source.quote: The National Lottery comes under the direct supervision of the government (via the Minister of Finance and the Minister of the Budget).
